POST /projects/.notes: `steps` cannot be set here: the server marks it read-only and ignores it (verified 2026-11-12).

PATCH /projects/{id}/.notes: Writable fields are name, description, available_locales, help_config, uploaded_documents and deleted_documents. A `steps` array is accepted with status 200 but ignored: the server marks it read-only, so this call does not add or change steps (verified 2026-11-12). Rename or rewire an existing step with `sdm projects steps patch`; configure it with the command of its type (`sdm mapping patch --action-id <step id>`, `sdm extension patch ...`).

PATCH /projects/{project_pk}/steps/{id}/.notes: `--id` is the step id from the project's `steps` array. The same id is the `--action-id` of the step-type commands and of `sdm steps hooks`.

GET /steps/{action_id}/hooks/.notes: `--action-id` is a step id from a project's `steps` array.

POST /steps/{action_id}/hooks/.notes: The API publishes no body schema for hooks and the shape has not been verified; read an existing hook with `sdm steps hooks get --action-id <step id>` and mirror its fields.

POST /auth/token/.notes: Use `sdm login` instead, which also stores the key. Asking again with the same token_name returns the same key.
